why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Jake Bauers is slot #2 (4.535 expected team runs/game).
Slots #2, #1, #3, #6, #7, #5, #8, #4, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #5 ranks 6 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.005 R/G.
Slot #2 yields 4.59 expected PA/game vs 4.27 at primary slot #5. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
